_comment: Isolated morale-recovery scenario (#657): single infantry unit, started already ROUTING via the scenario's starting_state field (no enemy ever on the field, so nothing can interfere), recovers morale in isolation and rallies back to IDLE. Mirrors test_morale_recovery_demo_scenario.gd's staging: morale is pinned low (1.0) so the recovery is gradual instead of an instant one-tick rally, and drill mode keeps the battle from declaring a false victory the moment it sees zero team-1 units. State-dump verified (tools/demo/dump-state.sh): morale climbs from 1.0 -> ~35 and the unit rallies (ROUTING -> IDLE) at tick 355 (60Hz dump basis), near y=-23 after fleeing from its y=400 spawn -- a router now builds up to its real flee pace, so it covers ~420 wu where it used to crawl ~160 (to y~242). It rallies at full flight, so it pulls up over about 97 wu, braking at its own decel with its men keeping step, and stands at y~-120 from tick 460. Camera frames the recovering unit from a close zoom to show individual soldier detail, panning to track the flee and arriving at the rally (tick 180, in this manifest's 30fps recording basis -- see demos/README.md's note on the two tick bases), then following the halt to where the block comes to rest (tick 240) and holding.
